subject: Post-demo: clarify hosting fit & migration timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: James O'Connor <j.oconnor@finprimex.com>, Katie Hudson <katie.hudson@finprimex.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: clarify hosting fit & migration timeline

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the clear use-case walkthrough. I wanted to capture the quick notes and ask a couple of clarifying questions so we can size the right hosting recommendation (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and propose a migration plan that meets your compliance and performance needs.

Recap (what we heard today)
- Primary workload: multi-turn financial analysis + document ingestion for customer support.
- Latency SLO: p95 ~ <200ms for short prompts; batch jobs ok to be higher.
- Data sensitivity: regulatory data in scope, some PII — likely requires network isolation for ingestion.
- Current footprint: mix of OpenAI API for prototyping + an older on-prem GPU cluster for specialized models.

Clarifying questions (short answers would be great):
1) Preferred long-term hosting outcome: are you leaning toward (a) Redwood Hosted for fastest time-to-value, (b) Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput, or (c) Private (VPC/on-prem) because of regulatory isolation?
2) Migration pattern: will you cutover from OpenAI first, then migrate on-prem models later? Or do you expect a hybrid steady-state (OpenAI for some calls, Dedicated/Private for regulated traffic)?
3) Can you share expected average QPS and a peak QPS target for the first 90 days?
4) Any specific compliance gates we should know about (data residency, custom encryption keys/KMS, SOC2/ISO requests)?

Next steps I propose:
- We'll send a one-pager comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) tailored to FinPrimeX constraints + a migration checklist.
- Schedule a 30-minute technical sync (product + infra) to walk your infra owner through VPC options and data flows.

Attachments: redwood-hosting-comparison.xlsx (comparison matrix), soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 scope & SOC2 report request path).

If you can reply with quick answers to the clarifying Qs above, we'll scope the MAP and pricing ballpark. Available this Thursday morning PT for a tech sync — does 11:00 PT work?

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
From: James O'Connor <j.oconnor@finprimex.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Hudson <katie.hudson@finprimex.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: clarify hosting fit & migration timeline

Thanks, Soojin — good demo and great questions. Short answers below to help you scope: 

1) Hosting preference: we're currently leaning toward Dedicated for predictable throughput, but Private VPC is required for our payments/regulatory flows. So likely a hybrid approach (Dedicated + Private VPC for regulated endpoints).
2) Migration pattern: plan is to cutover customer-facing inference from OpenAI to Redwood Dedicated over ~8 weeks; our on-prem cluster will be used for specialized models for now and may be phased into Private later.
3) QPS: expected steady-state 40 qps with peaks ~120 qps during end-of-day processing. Early months lower (10-15 qps).
4) Compliance: must support SOC2-level controls, KMS for key management, and EU data residency for some customers.

Can we do the tech sync Thursday at 11:00 PT? Also please send SOC2 summary and an initial pricing ballpark for Dedicated with burst capacity. Procurement will want a short statement of work for onboarding.

Thanks,
James O'Connor
Head of AI Ops, FinPrimeX
j.oconnor@finprimex.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-23T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: clarify hosting fit & migration timeline

Great notes — adding a few operational points from the Dedicated/Private perspective so procurement/infra has context: 

- Hybrid pattern is common: Southbound regulated traffic into Private VPC (customer-managed peering) while non-sensitive payloads route to Dedicated pools. That avoids wholesale on-prem migration up-front.
- We can support KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) and offer region pinning for EU-resident models.
- Migration support: we provide a migration checklist (attached: migration-checklist.csv) that covers tokenization differences, model variant compatibility, and a short A/B evaluation plan for parity testing.
- On pricing: ballpark for Dedicated capacity to hit 40 qps steady with 120 qps bursts depends on model family and sequence length — I'll draft a preliminary SKU set after we confirm typical prompt sizes.

Suggested immediate deliverables from our side:
1) Tailored hosting comparison XLSX (will send today).
2) SOC2 summary + how to request full audit package (soc2-summary.pdf attached).
3) Draft MAP: technical sync Thurs 11:00 PT; Redwood to deliver comparison + pricing by Tue EOD; FinPrimeX to provide sample prompt set and a list of compliance owners.

Looping in Rohan (cc) as the engineering contact — Rohan, James mentioned the on-prem cluster and custom models; would you be able to join the tech sync?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: clarify hosting fit & migration timeline — next steps / MAP

Perfect — thanks for the quick replies, James. Confirming the tech sync Thursday 11:00 PT (I'll send the calendar invite now). Below is the mutual action plan (MAP) so everyone has clear owners and due dates.

MAP (summary)
- Redwood: Finalize and send redwood-hosting-comparison.xlsx + pricing SKUs (owner: Soojin) — due Tue 2026-11-24 EOD PT.
- Redwood: Send soc2-summary.pdf and instructions for full SOC2 request (owner: Marcus) — sent 2026-11-23, attached.
- FinPrimeX: Share sample prompt set, expected sequence lengths, and compliance owner contact (owner: FinPrimeX) — due Mon 2026-11-29.
- Redwood + FinPrimeX: Technical sync (participants: R&D lead Rohan Mehta, Marcus, Stephanie) — Thu 2026-11-26 11:00 PT.
- Procurement: Draft SOW/Onboarding statement for Dedicated + Private VPC option (owner: FinPrimeX Procurement) — target before contract review.

Action items before the sync:
- FinPrimeX to confirm whether EU residency applies to the initial cutover traffic.
- FinPrimeX to share a simple test corpus (10–20 representative prompts) so we can run parity checks during the sync.

I'll attach the comparison and calendar invite in a follow-up. If procurement wants a short-form commercial summary for internal review, I can generate that today.

Thanks all — looking forward to the sync.

Soojin Lee
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
